name: BHS Conservation Fund
summary: Grants for practical amphibian and reptile conservation work in the UK, such as pond creation and habitat management tools and materials, plus funds to buy UK sites with rare herpetofauna.

eligibility.rule: For site purchases, the site has a management plan in place
For project grants, has the site owner's permission for the project

geography.quote: the fund can give grants up to £1500 for practical conservation work in the UK such as pond creation

access.quote: To apply, download the relevant application form, which can be filled in on your computer, and return by email the BHS Conservation officer.

amount.quote: the fund can give grants up to £1500 for practical conservation work in the UK such as pond creation

effort.quote: To apply, download the relevant application form, which can be filled in on your computer, and return by email the BHS Conservation officer.

eligibility.quote: with a management plan in place
Confirm that permission has been given by the site owner for the project

after_award.quote: The applicant must submit a report one month after completion of the project including at least 2 photographs and the numbers of people involved.
